stories.explanation: Premier dividende de l’histoire de la société, payable le 14 juillet 2026.
stories.story_fr: GlobalFoundries annonce son tout premier dividende trimestriel, à 0,12 $ par action.
stories.story_en: GlobalFoundries announces its first-ever quarterly dividend of $0.12 per share.
stories.citation: The quarterly dividend will be $0.12 per share, which will be payable on July 14, 2026 to shareholders of record as of June 24, 2026.

stories.name_fr: Part du flux de trésorerie retournée aux actionnaires
stories.name_en: Share of free cash flow returned to shareholders
stories.explanation: Flux de trésorerie disponible ajusté Non-IFRS des douze derniers mois, après investissements.
stories.story_fr: GlobalFoundries vise à retourner jusqu’à 50 % de son flux de trésorerie disponible ajusté aux actionnaires, par dividendes et rachats.
stories.story_en: GlobalFoundries targets returning up to 50% of trailing twelve-month adjusted free cash flow to shareholders through dividends and buybacks.
stories.citation: GF also unveiled its new capital allocation framework, which targets returning up to 50% of trailing twelve-month Non-IFRS adjusted free cash flow, after investments, to shareholders through dividends and share repurchases.
